hints.title: Duplicate Frequency
hints.text: The array contains integers from 0 to n-1 with exactly two integers appearing twice.

hints.title: Hash Set Membership
hints.text: Track numbers encountered in a hash set. The first time an integer is encountered again, record it.

hints.title: Collection and Termination
hints.text: Once both duplicate numbers are appended to the result, return them.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass over nums with O(1) hash set lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested loops for duplicate checking take O(n^2) time.
